name: M15 outside-envelope close continuation and fade screening batch

source_references.citation: Perry J. Kaufman, Trading Systems and Methods; frozen legacy backlog cites an unspecified edition at pages 111 and 157-158 for outside-bar/key-reversal context
source_references.supports: Wiley verifies current bibliographic metadata only. The cited pages were not opened and do not establish a cost-aware M15 FX rule; they motivate only the two-bar envelope territory.

research.evidence_summary: No inspected source establishes this M15 FX pattern. The legacy book context is weak and adjacent breakout/reversal families are adverse, so the strict outside-envelope close rule is a compact speculative falsification.

feasibility.rationale: The rule uses supported M1 OHLC, two contiguous completed M15 bars, signal-close fills, one fixed ATR stop and same-day exits; V2 still must confirm result transport.

market.session: Weekday signals from completed M15 bars ending 09:00 through 13:45 Europe/London; every exit due no later than 15:00

data.frequency: Interval-start M1 OHLC aggregated into Europe/London wall-clock M15 intervals
data.minimum_history: Fixed V2 development data only, with 98 valid observed M15 closes through t; elapsed gaps do not reset ATR, but event bars t-1 and t must be physically adjacent
preprocessing: Treat M1 timestamp ts as [ts,ts+1 minute) and require exactly 15 consecutive unique valid M1 candles per London M15 bar
Valid OHLC is finite and positive with high>=max(open,close), low<=min(open,close), high>=low; duplicates invalidate aggregation
Compute observed-sequence TR from previous observed close, seed Wilder ATR(96) from first 96 valid TRs, recur ATR_i=(95*ATR_{i-1}+TR_i)/96, and freeze through t-1
Use IANA Europe/London rules and canonical UTC storage
dependencies: V2 resolved signal-time spread, commission and slippage
limitations: A two-sided range expansion does not identify information or exhaustion
Completed-close entry may follow most of the move
Six correlated symbols and eight cells are not independent trials

hypothesis.behavior: When one completed M15 bar strictly exceeds both the prior high and low and closes beyond one prior extreme, that directional close may continue or fade.
hypothesis.mechanism: Continuation may reflect decisive repricing after absorbing both sides; fading may reflect a liquidity sweep whose completed close is already exhausted.
works_when: The outside range is material relative to prior ATR
One response sign survives both range thresholds and adjacent holds after costs
fails_when: The close-beyond-extreme filter enters too late
falsifiable_predictions: A response-mode center and at least one exact neighbor have positive net R
The center is positive in both UTC halves and at least three symbols
The center and required neighbor survive doubled costs and five-date removal

definitions.name: atr96_prior
definitions.formula: Wilder ATR(96) through t-1 over valid observed true ranges
definitions.timing: Frozen before signal bar t; require finite and positive

definitions.name: outside_envelope
definitions.timing: Both inequalities strict at completed t close

definitions.name: range_ratio
definitions.timing: Require >= range_atr_min at completed t close

definitions.name: close_break_direction
definitions.formula: +1 when outside_envelope and close_t>high_{t-1}; -1 when outside_envelope and close_t<low_{t-1}; otherwise no event
definitions.timing: Wick-only outside bars and closes inside/equal to the prior envelope are no event

definitions.name: trade_side
definitions.formula: close_break_direction for FOLLOW_CLOSE and -close_break_direction for FADE_CLOSE

entries.long_condition: eligible completed t AND range_ratio>=range_atr_min AND ((close_break_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_CLOSE) OR (close_break_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FADE_CLOSE)) AND cell flat
entries.short_condition: eligible completed t AND range_ratio>=range_atr_min AND ((close_break_direction=-1 AND response_mode=FOLLOW_CLOSE) OR (close_break_direction=+1 AND response_mode=FADE_CLOSE)) AND cell flat
entries.signal_time: Close of a London M15 interval ending 09:00 through 13:45 on a weekday when signal time plus holding_minutes is no later than 15:00
entries.execution_details: Enter at final M1 chart/bid close of completed t; V2 applies resolved or fixed-fallback spread, commission and slippage. Entry candle cannot trigger the new stop; management begins next M1.
entries.order_type: Market order at supported signal-close execution
restrictions: One open position per symbol per cell
No pyramiding or reset from overlap
t-1 and t are physically adjacent
Exact prior high/low equality is not outside and exact close at prior boundary is no event

exits.stop_loss: Long bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid-atr96_prior; short bid-chart stop=signal_close_bid+atr96_prior. Long triggers on bid, short on executable ask; adverse gaps fill at V2's worse executable open with all costs.
exits.time_exit: Exit at M1 close ending exactly signal_time plus holding_minutes; invalid M1 in (entry_time,due_exit_time] fails affected cells; on valid due bar STOP_LOSS precedes TIME_EXIT
exits.maximum_holding: At most 60 minutes and never after 15:00 Europe/London
exits.end_of_session: No entry may mature after 15:00 London; post-entry defects fail only affected cells

risk.position_sizing: Each cell owns an isolated portfolio. Within a cell, same-timestamp symbols size from one common pre-entry equity snapshot so chart stop risk is 0.25% before costs; no state crosses cells.
risk.gross_exposure_limit: Per cell at most six symbols and 1.50% aggregate initial stop risk; no cap shared across eight portfolios
risk.leverage: Use lower of stop-risk size and V2 limits; skip unrepresentable size
risk.concurrent_positions: Within each cell one per symbol and six total; all eight cells have independent position/equity/exposure/overlap/failure state

experiment.baseline: range_atr_min=1.0, response_mode=FOLLOW_CLOSE, holding_minutes=60, fixed stop=1 ATR
robustness_tests: Report all eight cells and retain complete contemporaneous breadth ledger
Report every symbol and UTC-midpoint development half; midpoint close belongs to first half
Double spread, commission and slippage individually
For each mode center threshold=1.0/hold=60 remove its five best normal-cost London dates from center and exact neighbors threshold=1.5 and hold=30; require retained normal/doubled net R positive
For each center/neighbor use eligible London weekdays including zeros and 10000 circular five-date block-bootstrap resamples with seed 2026013; center normal-cost lower bound must exceed zero
A mode advances only if center and at least one of threshold=1.5 or hold=30 passes every gate
costs: Use resolved or frozen-fallback spread, commission and slippage at every fill
No swap because exits precede 15:00 London
benchmarks: Opposite response mode on identical events
experiment.multiple_testing: Count all 312 selectable R007-R013 cells, R008's two diagnostics, and every named legacy trial including I-12 outside-bar/key-reversal and R008/R009 related breakout/geometry variants. Cross-batch promotion uses the full ledger. Incomplete historical IDs prohibit confirmation; no best-cell/family rescue.
rejection_criteria: Reject mode unless center and at least one exact neighbor are positive after normal/doubled costs
Reject if center is non-positive in either UTC half or fewer than three symbols are positive in each half
Reject if center has fewer than 200 pooled trades
Reject if five-date removal makes center or required neighbor non-positive
Reject if center bootstrap lower bound is not above zero
Reject promotion if required cells fail data integrity
Never access final holdout without explicit authorization for a separately frozen promoted version

pseudocode: Build valid London M15 bars causally.
Require strict high/low outside envelope and completed close strictly beyond one prior extreme.
Apply range threshold, map follow/fade and enter flat cells at signal close.
From next M1 process stop before due exit and fail only affected cells on defects.
Publish eight cells, neighbors, robustness and full breadth ledger.
required_libraries: existing V2 candle, timezone, cost, fill and R-accounting components
edge_cases: strict outside inequalities and strict close break
wick-only outside bar is no event
event-pair gap suppresses signal while elapsed gaps remain in ATR
adverse gap uses worse executable open
implementation.computational_requirements: One causal pass per symbol with shared envelope features and isolated eight-cell portfolios.
known_backtester_gaps: Queue waits for V2 M15/fill/cell-state compatibility and required result rows
